`r this_department`
=======================================================

```{r}

# Historical costs for only the current department
these_historical_costs <- historical_costs %>%
  filter(department == this_department) %>%
  mutate(is_forecast = FALSE)

these_forecasted_costs <- forecasts %>%
  filter(
    department == this_department,
    forecasted_on == max(forecasted_on)
    ) %>%
  mutate(is_forecast = TRUE) %>%
  rename(
    date = forecast_date,
    cost = forecasted_cost
  )

these_costs <- bind_rows(
  these_historical_costs,
  these_forecasted_costs
) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as_date(date),
    fy = to_fy(date)
    ) %>%
  filter(fy %in% to_fy(today() + years(c(-1, 0, 1))))

```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}

these_costs %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cost)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = is_forecast)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "FALSE" = "black",
      "TRUE" = "springgreen4"),
    labels = c(
      "FALSE" = "Historical",
      "TRUE" = "Forecasted"
    ),
    name = ""
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = forecasted_cost_lower_80, ymax = forecasted_cost_upper_80),
    alpha = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = forecasted_cost_lower_95, ymax = forecasted_cost_upper_95),
    alpha = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_x_date(name = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    name = "Monthly Cost (CAD)",
    labels = scales::dollar) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle(
    paste0("Historical and Forecasted Monthly Costs for ", this_department),
    subtitle = "With 80% and 95% Confidence Intervals"
  )

```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.5}

if (this_department %in% c("CRA / ARC", "ESDC / EDSC")) {
  fy_colors <- c(
    "FY2023-24" = "#e41a1c", 
    "FY2024-25" = "#377eb8", 
    "FY2025-26" = "#4daf4a",
    "FY2026-27" = "#984ea3",
    "FY2027-28" = "#ff7f00"
  )
  
  month_names <- format(
    seq(from = as_date("2025-04-01"),
        to = as_date("2026-03-31"),
        by = "1 month"),
    "%b")
  
  
  # Calculate month of the fiscal year for each data point
  these_costs$fy_month  <- ((month(these_costs$date) + 8) %% 12) + 1
  
  these_costs %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fy_month, y = cost)) +
    geom_line(
      lwd = 1,
      aes(
        color = fy,
        linetype = is_forecast)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = fy_colors,
      name = ""
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "",
      breaks = 1:12,
      minor_breaks = NULL,
      labels = month_names
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Monthly Cost (CAD)",
      labels = scales::dollar
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(1, 2),
      name = "",
      labels = c("Historical", "Forecasted")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle(
      paste0("Historical and Forecasted Monthly Costs for ", this_department),
      subtitle = "Displayed year-over-year to emphasize seasonality"
    )
}

```
